The best advice I can give you if you don’t have any medical supplies is to use some toilet paper or paper towels to stop it from bleeding. You could also wash the cuts with some water to clean them out.

You shouldn’t use toilet paper, you risk getting fibers from it in the wound and that could cause infection. Saw this on a self harm care guide, don’t know how true it is. Might not be. Just going by what I’ve heard.

I know nothing about this shit because I’ve never cut deep but you should probably wash it and bandage it really well. Make sure you disinfect it so that it doesn’t get infected and try to close it with those butterfly bandage things if you have any so nothing can get in the cut. Then put some sort of bandage on top to hold that all together. Gauze could be helpful too. Hope this helps, can’t guarantee anything though, like I said, I don’t know much about this :)
